releases.name: CLOSURE-13 dc5b405 · Mac reference · WINDOWS_NOT_RUN
releases.body:
CLOSURE-13 candidate: host source dc5b405f69535df84228199b40ce84048aa153b0; independent observation source 6507edb4c10699df3bdeb8f91da3bf31f81b94f9; independent integration source 01038cc5e21d200e4545c0a26594adc05eb62923.

Core engineering and Mac reference verification passed, including immutable package identity, static managed dependency closure, actual Supply/Inspection assembly startup/commands/query/stop, two independent installed plugin kinds, original-request Unknown recovery, cancellation, failed activation and retained Stop/Dispose ownership. WPF cross-build passed.

**WINDOWS_NOT_RUN**: actual WPF interaction/screenshots, Windows account/UAC/ACL/DPI/resolution/input/listening/continuous journey remain deferred by the user's decision. SDK/WCS/field qualification remains BLOCKED. These are reference candidates, not an accepted Windows or site release. TEST ONLY trust is explicitly separate; no private key, customer protocol, production data or vendor SDK is included.

Use closure13-CANDIDATE.json and closure13-SHA256SUMS.txt for exact combinations, source identities and hashes. ZIPs contain their own file hash list, composition lock, configuration and operating/development guides. Independent source archives and signed .ipcx packages are also provided. Portable candidates require .NET10.0.402; Windows candidate is self-contained and awaits actual Windows acceptance.

DELIVERY-12 assets and acceptance records remain unchanged. The withdrawn local 701ee0d attempt was never uploaded. Full AC13 implementation/evidence and current PR are recorded in docs/runtime/arch-extension-closure-13.md on the development branch.

Full download/byte/ZIP/file verification is published in closure13-READBACK.json. Its VerifiedFileCount is the exact ordinary file count including SHA256SUMS; the initial CANDIDATE FileCount counted both files and directories. No candidate package bytes were replaced.

releases.name: CLOSURE-13 maintenance patch 8cb475b (WINDOWS_NOT_RUN)
releases.body:
CLOSURE-13 PR12 maintenance patch candidate, frozen host source 8cb475b880e6cdd248db42bff74accf443c83519. Selected service/device renames now replace the original instance/binding; duplicate identities/ports are rejected. Explicit new-instance action preserves existing instances.

Mac reference checks and published core/dual extension/business assembly smoke passed; WPF cross-build passed. **WINDOWS_NOT_RUN**: actual UI, UAC/ACL, DPI, keyboard/scanner/touch/audio and continuous Windows acceptance are deferred by user decision. Real SDK/WCS/field qualification remains BLOCKED. This is a test-signed reference prerelease, not production approval.

Both plugins are version 1.0.1, built independently against this frozen host. Barcode source 6507edb4c10699df3bdeb8f91da3bf31f81b94f9; integration source 01038cc5e21d200e4545c0a26594adc05eb62923. ExtensionContract remains 1; Storage/MinimumReader remain 3. Exact combinations, raw signed manifest identities and hashes are in CANDIDATE.json and SHA256SUMS. Provision the separately supplied TEST ONLY public policy through the documented independent trust channel. No private key is included.

Prior dc5b405 and DELIVERY-12 candidates retain original bytes and historical acceptance. Do not re-sign a different 1.0.0 or delete immutable store registrations; outstanding requests retain original identity and remain blocked if their exact old capability is unavailable. Use existing safe maintenance/activation steps; installation is not activation.

Build-tool fix: map the physical macOS temporary root so fresh builds produce identical signed manifests/payloads across portable and win-x64 hosts. Eight actual independent builds verify exact content. The withdrawn a1c41bc attempt was never uploaded; failure evidence is retained in the PR. Baseline maintenance tests preserve CAS assertions and re-read only explicitly rejected pre-execution conflicts.

Publication closure (2026-10-17): PR #12 merged into main as 8cabf06d3c6d53ba551b65e58a13db6cdcaba16a. The PR contains 11 content commits; main gained 12 commits including the merge. Code, reports, docs, manifest and execution evidence are included. This publication task ran no tests, builds, validation scripts or repackaging (NOT_RUN); prior implementation results retain their original evidence identity. The 12 existing assets remain unchanged. WINDOWS_NOT_RUN and real SDK/WCS/field BLOCKED remain unchanged.
